task: Compare v4 joint exploratory reference NNLS PGAM5 RNA-detected macrophage relative estimates across pathological AJCC stage
estimates: Fresh NNLS refit for371primarypatients using exact v4 joint850gene17component reference; target TAM_PGAM5_detected. No reference retraining; 778 measured genes used
stage_primary: UCSCXenaShiny tcga_clinical.rda, typeLIHC,primary01 sample, ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage; same mirror project used for prior survival, stage sourceToilHub. No clinical stage/grade/BCLC substitute
stage_sensitivity: GSE62944 companion2015 clinical table,ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage matched exactly to selected RNA_sample; source-specific stages, no filling missing from other source. Clinical-source discrepancies explicitly listed
stage_mapping: Full-string matchStageI/IA/IB/IC->I,II/IIA/IIB/IIC->II,III/IIIA/IIIB/IIIC->III,IV/IVA/IVB/IVC->IV. Missing,NotAvailable,Discrepancy,etc excluded. User-requested pooling: III and IV -> III-IV; preserve original major stage in provenance
primary_test: All valid stageI,II,III-IV coefficient values INCLUDING zeros, independent patients; Kruskal-Wallis asymptotic plus20000label permutation p due many zero ties. III-IV pooling explicitly requested by user; no outcome-driven threshold
pairwise: Three predeclared stage pairs, Mann-Whitney U(two-sided asymptotic,tie-aware,no continuity) plus20000rank-label permutation p;BH across three permutation p values within each source. Rank-biserial=2U/(nA*nB)-1 positive means stageA estimates greater
secondary: Ordered stage Spearman and3x2stage-by-nonzero-estimate chi-square;20000permutation p with fixedstage sizes. BH across these two secondary permutation p values per source. Nonzero is model coefficient>0, not proven cell presence
permutation: Fixed seeds, Monte Carlo p=(extreme+1)/(B+1), all source analyses use same predetermined B=20000. Sensitivity does not select preferred p/source
descriptive: N,zero/nonzero counts,median,Q1,Q3,mean,IQR,Wilson95%CI nonzero proportion; box/jitter and proportion plot. Coefficient*100 is relative model-mixture percentage, not calibrated tissue cell fraction
limitations: Exploratory v4 joint reference failed external validation; public mirror stage dates/editions differ. III-IV merged by user request;unadjusted cross-sectional tests, no confounder/causal/clinical validation claim. No change to prior survival results
